title: Finding Equivalent Models in SEM
text: Suppose going fit model three latent variables:
code: mod <- " fx =~ x1 + x2 + x3 fm =~ m1 + m2 + m3 fy =~ y1 + y2 + y3 fm ~ fx fy ~ fm + fx " library(lavaan) fit <- sem(   model = mod,   data = data_test_3_factor_3_item ) fit #> lavaan 0.6-21 ended normally after 41 iterations #>  #>   Estimator                                         ML #>   Optimization method                           NLMINB #>   Number of model parameters                        21 #>  #>   Number of observations                           200 #>  #> Model Test User Model: #>                                                        #>   Test statistic                                24.970 #>   Degrees of freedom                                24 #>   P-value (Chi-square)                           0.407
